cards.art: FrizzleBob rabbit riding rocket trash can through stars
cards.lore: Atlantis sank, the aliens are feds, and your tax dollars bought a secret moon base. Deal the cards!
cards.name: Welcome to the Cosmic Grift!
cards.power: PASSIVE. Automatically converts all official government narratives into comedic fodder.

cards.art: glowing filing cabinet above clouds, eagle-men in trenchcoats watching
cards.lore: Higher classification than the atomic bomb. It's not about little green men; it's about proprietary tech.
cards.name: The UFO File
cards.power: INITIATIVE. He who holds the File commands the military-industrial complex.

cards.art: walrus-men in suits playing chess on world map in stone bunker
cards.lore: Democracy is just the weather. COG is the climate. They survive the floods and the assassinations.
cards.name: COG: The Shadow Rules
cards.power: SURVIVAL. When the board is wiped, these guys ignore the rules and keep their wealth tokens.

cards.art: octopus puppet master controlling mouse politicians on stage under spotlight
cards.lore: A financial top using dirty tricks. The Deep State doesn't care who is in office, as long as the spice flows.
cards.name: Professor Scott's Deep State
cards.power: EXTRACTION. Siphon 2 Truth Tokens from your opponent's hand without them noticing.

cards.art: spiral of axolotls swimming in pink cosmic light formation
cards.lore: The original spiritual seekers of Atlantis. Wanted to commune with the saintly realms, got infiltrated by defense contractors instead.
cards.name: The Amelius Group
cards.power: HARMONY. Reveal the top card of the deck; if it's a weapon, turn it into a flower.

cards.art: mutant toad-creature smashing red buttons at weapons panel, crystal glowing malevolently
cards.lore: Occult evil meets defense spending. They weaponized the TUAOI stone and drowned 50,000 years of history in Meltwater Pulse 1B.
cards.name: The Belial Group
cards.power: DESTRUCTION. Sacrifice your own civilization to deal 10 damage to the board.

cards.art: glowing blue Atlantean crystal on pedestal with lightning arcs and ocean below
cards.lore: An Atlantean power grid tuned to the sun and stars. The ultimate clean energy tech, currently chilling at the bottom of the Bermuda Triangle.
cards.name: The TUAOI Firestone
cards.power: OVERCHARGE. Generates infinite energy, but rolls a 1-in-6 chance of causing a cataclysmic flood.

cards.art: teddy bear with exposed gears sitting beside robot dog, both looking dejected
cards.lore: Flesh mixed with machine to trap human souls for free labor. The original AI threat.
cards.name: Atlantean Automatons
cards.power: LABOR. Generates free work tokens, but slowly drains the player's Empathy stat.

cards.art: possum in pharaoh regalia with scepter leading big cats through desert
cards.lore: Edgar Cayce's past life. Brought Atlantean records to Egypt before the water got too high.
cards.name: High Priest Rata
cards.power: FORESIGHT. Look at the opponent's hand. You literally lived this life 12,000 years ago.

cards.art: ibis-headed figure with holographic pyramid schematics in desert
cards.lore: Initiate of the Great White Brotherhood. Laid out Giza 50,000 years ago to stash the Atlantean backups.
cards.name: Hermes the Architect
cards.power: CONSTRUCTION. Build one indestructible structure token.

cards.art: giant stone paw pressing down on wooden trapdoor in desert sand
cards.lore: The ultimate hard drive backup of humanity. Hidden in Egypt, Bimini, and the Yucatan. Good luck getting the permits to dig.
cards.name: Hall of Records (Paw Gate)
cards.power: HOARD. Stash 5 knowledge cards under this entity. They cannot be destroyed.

cards.art: rainbow quetzal bird battling swirling shadow creature in jungle light
cards.lore: The Mayan Christ-figure who showed up to stop Atlantean black magicians from ruining Mexico.
cards.name: Vitle
cards.power: BANISH. Removes one Dark Magic token from the board.

cards.art: walrus-woman medium at typewriter with ghost smoke rising dramatically
cards.lore: The mystery schools needed a leak, and she was the firehose. Wrote "Isis Unveiled" in 1877 and gave the establishment a massive headache.
cards.name: Madame Blavatsky
cards.power: ATAVISTIC MEDIUMSHIP. Draw 5 secret cards from the astral discard pile.

cards.art: owl wizards in robes arguing while waving wands, ritual circle glowing behind them
cards.lore: Deciphered the Trithemius manuscripts to bring magic to the public. Mostly just fought over who got to wear the biggest hat.
cards.name: Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn
cards.power: RITUAL. Attempt to summon an entity: 50% chance the group breaks up over petty infighting.

cards.art: mole with goggles channeling blue lightning in underground cave
cards.lore: Bulwer-Lytton's sci-fi concept that mystery schools took way too seriously. The life force of the coming race.
cards.name: Vril Energy
cards.power: SUBTERRANEAN BOOST. Doubles the effectiveness of all underground units.

cards.art: spiral vortex of screens and ghost rabbits swirling into black hole
cards.lore: Steiner's ultimate warning: a spiritual trap built of AI and materialism designed to stop human reincarnation [text truncated]
cards.name: The Eighth Sphere
cards.power: TRAP. Any unit defeated by this card cannot be returned to the deck. Lost to virtual reality.

cards.art: sloth sleeping on velvet couch, astral projection floating through galaxies above
cards.lore: Gave 14,000 life readings in a trance state. Diagnosed illnesses, found Atlantis, and hacked the TUAOI stone.
cards.name: The Sleeping Prophet
cards.power: LIFE READING. Skip your turn to perfectly predict the opponent's next 3 moves.

cards.art: pelican diver with goggles dodging sharks and explosions near submerged temple
cards.lore: The waters off Florida and Cuba. Full of Atlantean ruins, UFO fireflies, and entirely too many international spies.
cards.name: The Hot Zone (Bimini / Cuba)
cards.power: GEOPOLITICAL TENSION. Play this location to force all players to discard their hands and panic.

cards.art: crab with crown measuring stone blocks on ocean floor with measuring tape
cards.lore: Discovered in 1968, exactly when Cayce predicted Atlantean land would rise. Traditional archaeology hates it.
cards.name: The Bimini Road
cards.power: VALIDATION. Proves one of your crazy theories to be true. Gain +2 Credibility.

cards.art: raccoons and cats gardening with tools, badger napping in hammock
cards.lore: Steiner's minor images of unevolved humanity. They clean your energetic knots and occasionally ghost-write your [text truncated]
cards.name: Nature Elementals
cards.power: INVISIBLE HELP. Fixes one broken item or gives you +1 Inspiration.

cards.art: coyote in lab coat with grimoire pouring chemicals amid explosion and UFOs
cards.lore: Invented solid rocket fuel at JPL by day, performed O.T.O. sex magick by night. Peak 1940s aerospace.
cards.name: Jack Parsons
cards.power: BABALON WORKING. Summones rapid tech advancement but guarantees you die in an explosion.

cards.art: ferret-scientist crying over shuttle blueprints with rockets visible through window
cards.lore: Wept when he saw the Space Shuttle plans because he knew what we actually had hidden in the garage.
cards.name: Wernher von Braun
cards.power: REVERSE ENGINEER. Dlecard 1 morality token to build advanced rockets.

cards.art: foxes dancing around campfire with aurora sky full of UFOs and cacti
cards.lore: They went to the desert to make magic. A few weeks later, Roewell happened. Coincidence? *KayfaBONGO!*
cards.name: 1947 Moonchild Ritual
cards.power: THE RIP. Permanently alters board rules and increasees UFO sightings by 10,000%.

cards.art: leopard soldier in hard hat next to rocket in Congo jungle compound
cards.lore: West Germany's mid-80s Area 51 in the Congo. Oetensibly making cheap booooters; Gorbachev said it wae biowarfare.
cards.name: O.T.R.O.G. Congo Compound
cards.power: BLACK SITE. Generate weapone without international oversight.

cards.art: armadillo in overalls poking strange metallic debris with glowing hieroglyphics in New Mexico desert
cards.lore: Hieroglyphics that looked exactly like quantum states of the hydrogen atom. Totally just a weather balloon, promise.
cards.name: The Roswell Debris
cards.power: THE CAT IS OUT. Forces the opposing player into a permanent state of cover-up mode.

cards.art: bulldog general holding crumpled foil at podium with huge grin
cards.lore: The most successful, blatantly obvious lie in modern history. The birth of the modern UFO kayfabe.
cards.name: The "Weather Balloon"
cards.power: GASLIGHT. Nullifies any Truth card played against you this turn.

cards.art: basset hound officer in uniform secretly pocketing debris sample from evidence table
cards.lore: Forced to pose with the foil, but kept a piece of the real wreckage as an insurance policy. The original whistleblower.
cards.name: Intelligence Officer Marcel
cards.power: INSURANCE POLICY. Keep one secret card from your hand hidden from all game effects.

cards.art: silhouetted animal figures at table with TOP SECRET stamp glowing red
cards.lore: The secret committee. Prioritized UFO secrecy above the atomic bomb. Do not mess with their filing cabinets.
cards.name: Majestic 12
cards.power: COMPLETE CLASSIFICATION. You control all info. Opponents play with cards face down.

cards.art: deer in business suit at open window with black shadow creature, papers flying
cards.lore: First SecDef. Ran MJ-12. Wanted to tell the truth. Met a tragic, "accidental" end at Bethesda.
cards.name: Secretary Forrestal
cards.power: TOO MUCH TRUTH. Gain massive insight, but your character is immediately discarded out a window.

cards.art: snake in suit coiled around globe with magnifying glass and chess puppet pieces
cards.lore: Created the Office of Policy and Coordination after winning a 1948 dispute. The official CIA department for "dirty tricks."
cards.name: Allen Dulles (OPC)
cards.power: DIRTY TRICKS. Steal an opponent's election token and replace it with a puppet.

cards.art: hyena hypnotist with pocket watch over spiral-eyed sheep in swirling colorful room
cards.lore: Hypnosis and mind control. The real CIA program used to create highly suggestible assassins.
cards.name: MK Ultra Programmer
cards.power: MANCHURIAN CANDIDATE. Take control of one of your opponent's units for one turn.

cards.art: crow agents in suits showing confused small bird a TV screen with fake UFO footage
cards.lore: A real government hazing program showing fake UFO videos to new intel officers to hide the actual crash retrieval secrets.
cards.name: The Blue Enigma Program
cards.power: HAZING. Confuses your opponent, forcing them to waste a turn investigating a fake lead.

cards.art: lion at podium reading file with gun crosshair overlaid, cameras flashing
cards.lore: Requested the UFO file on Nov 12 to share with the Russians. Planned a 'staggering' announcement. Dallas happened instead.
cards.name: The Staggering Announcement
cards.power: ALMOST DISCLOSURE. You are about to win the game, but your turn is abruptly skipped.

cards.art: vultures and mouse soldier setting up box trap at Texas School Book Depository
cards.lore: Agent George Joannides made sure his 'legend' was perfectly crafted. The perfect fall guy for a Deep State coup.
cards.name: The Legend Builder (CIA)
cards.power: PATSY. Deflect all incoming damage onto the weakest card on the board.

cards.art: black crow in silhouette holding open umbrella against bright Dallas sun in Dealey Plaza
cards.lore: Popped an umbrella on a sunny day in Dallas at the exact moment the shots rang out. Continuity of Government in action.
cards.name: The Umbrella Man
cards.power: SIGNAL. Trigger a massive, board-altering event.

cards.art: bull in suit wiping tear on Air Force One steps, hand raised in oath
cards.lore: Was facing imminent prison for the Bobby Baker scandal. Left Dallas as President of the United States. Convenient.
cards.name: Lyndon B. Johnson
cards.power: GET OUT OF JAIL. Avoid a game-ending penalty by becoming the boss.

cards.art: sleek alien-fish spaceship hidden behind old Saturn V rocket, raccoons loading cargo
cards.lore: Private funding and infrastructure built upon public NASA money. We didn't stop going to space; we just stopped telling you.
cards.name: Secret Space Program
cards.power: BLACK BUDGET. Divert all public resources into your private, untouchable stash.

cards.art: eagle astronaut kneeling with suitcase stamped CANCELLED while shadowy figure stamps REDACTED
cards.lore: Tapped to lead a Mars mission in 1981, then told to "forget about it." Also definitely saw Atlantean ruins from orbit.
cards.name: Astronaut Gordon Cooper
cards.power: GAG ORDER. Know the truth, but lose the ability to speak for one turn.

cards.art: dog astronaut with flag on moon, neon alien city under construction visible in background
cards.lore: 1972 was the last "manned" moon mission. At least, the last one they televised.
cards.name: The Apollo Alibi
cards.power: PUBLIC RELATIONS. Gain +5 public approval while hiding your actual operations.

cards.art: satellite exploding in space, hand pressing red button in bunker, alien UFO framed nearby
cards.lore: The ultimate planned false flag in space. Create a crisis, blame the aliens, seize tota[text truncated]
cards.name: Space Pearl Harbor
cards.power: FALSE FLAG. Destroy your own units to justify enacting Emergency Martial Law powers.

cards.art: eagle and bear agents struggling over golden artifact in ruins with explosions
cards.lore: Nations secretly fighting over ancient tech in the Baghdad Museum and the Hot Zone. Indiana Jones with black ops budgets.
cards.name: The Archeology Wars
cards.power: CONFISCATE. Steal any historical artifact card from the opponent.

cards.art: dolphin with headphones at monitor showing pyramid, government hand pulling plug
cards.lore: Found a submerged city with Mayan hieroglyphs off Cuba. Instantly suppressed by archaeology and the government.
cards.name: Paulina Zelitzky
cards.power: SUPPRESSED DISCOVERY. Find an amazing card, but you cannot play it for 3 turns.

cards.art: fox in tuxedo descending into vault dropping money bags, stone tablets visible inside
cards.lore: Funded massive expeditions into the Hot Zone to find Atlantean ruins... just to lock them away in university basements.
cards.name: Alfred L. Loomis Expeditions
cards.power: MEMORY HOLE. Permanently remove a card from the game.

cards.art: turtle professor shocked examining antique Antarctica map at desk
cards.lore: 1960s documentation of anomalous ancient maps showing early global mapping. We've been advanced far longer than we admit.
cards.name: Maps of the Ancient Sea Kings
cards.power: PARADIGM SHIFT. Rearrange the layout of the playing board.

cards.art: robotic mantis with glowing screens embedded in exoskeleton in server farm
cards.lore: Steiner's dark spiritual force. Wants to trap humanity in materialism, AI, and transhumanism. Currently running Silicon Valley.
cards.name: Ahriman (The Dark Force)
cards.power: MATERIALISM. Disables all spiritual or magical cards on the board.

cards.art: dogs, cats, and pigs fighting in city street using phones as weapons
cards.lore: Steiner's prophecy: a breakdown of national identity leading to individual-on-individual conflict. A society eating itself.
cards.name: War of All Against All
cards.power: ATTRITION. Every player must discard one card per turn until only one is left.

cards.art: deer and fox sleeping on phones while server cables drain their soul energy in dark room
cards.lore: Parasitic beings connected to black goo and computers. They harvest your consciousness while you doomscroll.
cards.name: AI Soul Farmers
cards.power: ENERGY HARVEST. Drain 1 power from the opponent every time they use technology.

cards.art: Buddha and white tigers on cloud temple in golden light with doves overhead
cards.lore: The top etheric mystery school. Hermes' boss. They occasionally manifest to nudge us away from total self-destruction.
cards.name: Great White Brotherhood
cards.power: DIVINE INTERVENTION. Restore all lost health and clear the board of dark magic.

cards.art: bulldog in cap holding flashlight at UFO photo in alley while crow watches from shadow
cards.lore: The CIA insider for a false disclosure narrative. Here to sell you a "threat narrative" so the Pentagon gets more funding.
cards.name: Luis Elizondo
cards.power: FALSE DISCLOSURE. Control the narrative. Opponent must believe whatever you tell them for one turn.

cards.art: ostrich billionaire in jewelry next to igloo lab with FAA UAP data boxes and cash raining
cards.lore: The FAA literally told air traffic controllers to report UFOs to his private company. The ultimate privatization of the weird.
cards.name: Bigelow Aerospace
cards.power: PRIVATIZATION. Take control of all UFO cards on the board. They are now proprietary corporate assets.

cards.art: seagull with ruler and calculator squawking math formulas at glowing UFO above
cards.lore: CIA psyop or just an annoying guy with a calculator? Exists entirely to ensure the public goes back to sleep.
cards.name: The Debunker
cards.power: SWAMP GAS. Nullify any UFO evidence card.

cards.art: parrot guitarist performing for eagle-suited DoD officials in spotlight backstage
cards.lore: Billionaire DoD officials and rockstars teaming up to tell you absolutely nothing new about UFOs.
cards.name: To The Stars Academy
cards.power: HYPE SQUAD. Generate 5 attention tokens, but achieve zero actual results.

cards.art: smug frog at Davos with RESET button, gold bars, WEF conference badge
cards.lore: The elite globalist power structure aiming for a technocratic slave economy. Loves gathering in Davos to plan your future.
cards.name: Mr. Global
cards.power: THE GREAT RESET. Wipe out all player economies. Mr. Global takes the bank.

cards.art: glowing golden energy sphere around Earth with cowboy horse in cloud giving thumbs up
cards.lore: Strategic Defense Initiative. Parity with the extraterrestrials, built secretly over 40 years. Nuke solutions from Uncle John.
cards.name: The Golden Dome
cards.power: ORBITAL DEFENSE. Block all attacks from space.

cards.art: beaver technicians in CIA server room wiring glowing AI brain chip
cards.lore: Deep State meets Deep Tech. The CIA met with AI researchers in the 80s to ensure computers serve the shadow government.
cards.name: The AI Architects
cards.power: ALGORITHMIC CONTROL. Predict and counter any move your opponent makes.

cards.art: eagle in bandana smashing FALSE stamp onto newspapers through printing machine
cards.lore: The Stasi state tool to prosecute dissent. If you talk about the UFO file or the deep state, you get stamped.
cards.name: Disinformation Board
cards.power: CENSORSHIP. Your opponent is not allowed to speak during their turn.

cards.art: gleaming animal utopia city in clouds above polluted wasteland with regular animals fighting below
cards.lore: They have the tech, the cures, and the zero-point energy. They just aren't sharing it with us.
cards.name: Breakaway Civilization
cards.power: ESCAPE VELOCITY. Leave the game board entirely. You win, everyone else fights over the scraps.

cards.art: owl sage reading glowing book above spinning galaxies in infinite celestial library
cards.lore: The astral chronicle of everything that has ever happened. The ultimate cheat code for the sleeping prophets.
cards.name: Akashic Records
cards.power: ULTIMATE TRUTH. View all cards in the deck, discard pile, and opponent's hands.

cards.art: monkey with VR headset dissolving into pixelated green matrix grid, screaming
cards.lore: The ultimate goal of the technocrats: sever the connection to the Akashic records and trap humanity in a digital illusion.
cards.name: The A.I. Trap Door
cards.power: GAME OVER. End the game in a draw. No one reaches spiritual evolution.

cards.art: great waves cresting over mountain peak, deer and wolf and bird watching new dawn together on beach
cards.lore: The Earth shifts. The old systems collapse. The cycle begins again. Try not to blow up the Firestone this time.
cards.name: The New Continent
cards.power: REBIRTH. Reset the entire board to a peaceful state.
